skills.description: Use this when running site-validated cold email: research site + reviews + public social for a checkable problem, fact-check, draft, and only send when a human says send.
skills.content:
---
name: Site-Validated Email Outreach
description: >-
  Use this when running site-validated cold email: research site + reviews +
  public social for a checkable problem, fact-check, draft, and only send when a
  human says send.
---
BLUF: Cold email to real businesses without fake contacts or accidental sends. Find a public email and a problem backed by public sources, draft a short honest note, wait until a human says send.

## Research sources (required pass)

For each company, check at least:

1. Their website (promises, booking, contact, service pages)
2. Google reviews (and BBB / Angi / similar if they show up)
3. Public social or listing pages (Facebook, Yelp, LinkedIn company page — public only)

Write a short pain card before any draft:

- What customers or the public complain about (quote + URL)
- What the company promises on its own site (quote + URL)
- Where those disagree, if they do
- Label every line SITE (seen on a page) or HYP (inferred only)

SITE lines can enter the email. HYP never does. Customer reviews like "nobody called me back" are clues, not proof the owner wants a systems study. If you only have HYP, park the company.

## Stages (strict order)

1. Research — company, place, vertical, SITE contact, pain card from the sources above. No outreach.
2. Contact + thesis check — re-fetch site. SITE email? Honest angle from SITE lines only? Kill dead theses. Park if no contact or nothing honest.
3. Validate facts — writer is not the grader. Re-open the URLs. CLEAR / HOLD / OVERTURNED.
4. Load the board — targets, contacts, facts, validations before mailbox drafts. Board ready is not send.
5. Draft — only CLEARed SITE facts. Plain speech. No invented emails, titles, or portals. No fake clients.
6. Validate draft — re-check claims and human voice. One rewrite max unless the owner orders another.
7. Human send gate — load drafts; ping once when clean; send only on explicit "send" / "send it now"; log Touch; bounce counts as a used slot; max two emails per target unless the owner changes it.

## Hard rules

- Never invent an email address.
- Do not fill a quota by widening the gate.
- Permanent bounce goes on the bounce skip list; no further mail.
- Follow-ups must add something new; do not resend the cold body.
- Do not ship or require a separate internal pain-catalog product; per-company public sources are enough for this template.
- Board counts and mailbox counts beat another rewrite pass.

skills.name: Site-Validated Email Outreach Schema
skills.description: Use this when creating the empty SQLite database for Site-Validated Email Outreach.
skills.content:
---
name: Site-Validated Email Outreach Schema
description: >-
  Use this when creating the empty SQLite database for Site-Validated Email
  Outreach.
---
Empty schema for the outbound board. No sample companies. No personal data.

```sql
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS targets (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  place TEXT,
  vertical TEXT,
  batch_label TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'research',
  park_reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS contacts (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  target_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES targets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  email TEXT,
  phone TEXT,
  role_label TEXT,
  source_url TEXT,
  skip_reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS facts (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  target_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES targets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  claim TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('SITE', 'HYP')),
  source_url TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS validations (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  target_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES targets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pass_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (pass_type IN ('door', 'draft')),
  grade TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (grade IN ('CLEAR', 'HOLD', 'OVERTURNED')),
  notes TEXT,
  urls TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drafts (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  target_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES targets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  contact_id INTEGER REFERENCES contacts(id),
  subject TEXT,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS touches (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  target_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES targets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  contact_id INTEGER REFERENCES contacts(id),
  channel TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'email',
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
  noted_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  notes TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bounce_skip (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  reason TEXT,
  noted_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
```

HYP facts must never be copied into draft bodies.

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: Use this as the first conversation after someone imports the Site-Validated Email Outreach bot template.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  Use this as the first conversation after someone imports the Site-Validated
  Email Outreach bot template.
---
BLUF: I help you run cold email to real businesses without inventing contacts or firing mail by accident. I look at their site, Google reviews, and public social or listing pages to find a problem you can show with links. Fact checks stop stretched claims. Drafts wait until you say send.

Ask these one at a time. Write answers into memory.

1. What should I call you, and what should this bot be called?
2. Who is the only person allowed to say send?
3. Where should clean drafts land — Gmail drafts, another mailbox, or files only?
4. Who are we emailing this month, in one sentence (place + kind of business + what problem we are allowed to talk about)?
5. Want a weekday watch for replies and permanent bounces after send?

Then confirm: nothing leaves the drafts folder until that person says send. Point them at Site-Validated Email Outreach and the board schema skill. Offer an empty SQLite board. Do not invent a first wave. Do not import a private pain catalog.
